scope: Bounded read-only triage of the nine packages in the captured audit, not a new full advisory census or Phase 5 completion. No install, auth, deploy, source/lock/dist modifications.

method.worker: Installed esbuild 0.28.2 bundle/write:false/metafile:true, browser platform, ESM, target es2022; only cloudflare:* and node:* external. Exact entrypoints from wrangler configs.
method.browser: Vite 6.4.5 production build/write:false/configFile:false with matching react and nodePolyfills plugins, aliases/dedupe; all dynamic chunks inspected. envDir/cacheDir/outDir and HOME isolated in scratch. Second build run from repository cwd so PostCSS/Tailwind discovery matches project. No index.html/dist writes. Module inventory from generateBundle distinguishes parsed modules from positive renderedLength.
method.limits: No remote deployment or exploitability claim. Node/deployment-only SDKs are installed but were not executed with accounts. Parsed graph can include tree-shaken code. Build probe uses empty envDir (no .env read); rerun final packaging with approved production nonsecret config after any dependency/source change. Inline package-vendored code cannot be exhaustively certified by package-name inventory alone.
method.warnings: Rollup PURE-annotation warnings. Initial scratch-cwd browser probe warned of empty Tailwind content; rerun from repository cwd completed without that warning. Initial env -i launch lacked node on PATH; corrected to explicit installed Node path.

advisories.title: @grpc/grpc-js: In certain configurations, getAuthContext can return unauthorized certificates as though they were authorized
@grpc/grpc-js: The server transmits some error messages thrown by method handlers to the client in status messages

packages.assessment: Lock-only Node Firebase branch; no gRPC server or certificate API is bundled into either Worker or emitted browser. The server-specific advisory preconditions are not established for this app.
packages.minimalRemediation: Candidate scoped @grpc/grpc-js 1.9.16 -> 1.13.6 (minor; CJS retained, Node >=12.10). Firebase requests ~1.9.0, so override is outside its declared range and requires Firebase/Circle regression tests. 1.14.0-1.14.4 are also affected upstream: do not choose them. No source/lock change made.

advisories.title: decode-uri-component vulnerable to denial of service via quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs
decode-uri-component: Denial of service via exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input

packages.assessment: Lock-only query-string branch, not emitted browser or Workers. DoS needs attacker-controlled malformed encoded input passed into this decoder, not merely a native URL parse.
packages.minimalRemediation: First release fixing both advisories is 0.5.1. No patched 0.2.x release found. Do NOT blindly override 0.2.2 -> 0.5.1: 0.5.1 is ESM-only while query-string 7.1.3 requires CommonJS. A consumer-compatible migration/backport is an unresolved gate, not an approved patch/minor fix.

advisories.title: Elliptic Uses a Cryptographic Primitive with a Risky Implementation

packages.assessment: Lock-only ethers-v5/signing and Node crypto-browserify polyfill branches. Vite transforms none of elliptic; neither Worker includes it. Actual Arc signing uses approved viem/injected wallet flow, not this library. Absence in these bundles does not justify using it in future server signing.
packages.minimalRemediation: No patched release: registry latest is 6.6.1 and GHSA has no first_patched_version. Preserve approved Circle SDKs. Keep elliptic away from funded-key/signature code; upstream replacement/backport or explicit reviewed non-reachability disposition required.

advisories.title: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response

packages.assessment: Only @esbuild-kit/core-utils nested 0.18.20 is affected. Root 0.28.2 and Vite/drizzle-kit nested 0.25.12 are not. This is development server exposure, not emitted application code; using transform to build is not evidence that the vulnerable serve API runs.
packages.minimalRemediation: Candidate scoped @esbuild-kit/core-utils>esbuild 0.18.20 -> 0.25.12 (0.x minor jump, NOT guaranteed API-compatible). Scratch-only module substitution successfully exercised core-utils.transformSync on TypeScript. Require full Drizzle generate/migration-helper regression in isolated scratch before an override. First patched is 0.25.0; no patched 0.18.x. Never downgrade root or Vite esbuild.

advisories.title: stream-json: JSONC parser and verifier re-scan the whole accumulated comment on every input chunk
stream-json has a prototype pollution issue: Assembler writes this.current[this.key] on plain objects
stream-json: pick/ignore/filter/replace filters are O(depth²) on nested input — small crafted JSON blocks the event loop for seconds→minutes (DoS)

packages.assessment: Lock-only jayson Node stream-parser branch. Browser entry uses jayson browser/client, which is not proof of streaming-server reachability. Bounded direct installed-code check confirmed local parsed-object prototype injection in 1.9.1, not global Object.prototype pollution. No Workers/browser inclusion. JSONC advisory describes APIs absent from 1.x; broad audit range is retained, not treated as proof every advisory mechanism exists in 1.9.1.
packages.minimalRemediation: All listed fixes require stream-json >=3.6.0; no patched 1.x release found. Do NOT override jayson ^1.9.1 to 3.6.0: ESM, changed subpaths/API and stream-chain major change; jayson requires stream-json/streamers/StreamValues and utils/Verifier. Upstream compatible backport/consumer fix remains a gate.

advisories.title: toml-node: Uncontrolled Recursion
toml-node: Prototype Pollution Leads to `Object.prototype` Corruption via `__proto__` Key-Path Desynchronization
toml-node: Quadratic-complexity DoS via many array-of-tables headers in toml.parse()
toml-node: Quadratic-complexity DoS via long dotted keys or table paths in toml.parse()
toml-node: Uncontrolled resource consumption (CPU DoS) via unbounded-length integer literals in toml.parse()

packages.assessment: Lock-only Anchor workspace configuration branch. Source package workspace.js imports toml to parse local Anchor.toml; neither Worker nor emitted browser contains it. A malicious local/deployment config would be a separate trust boundary, not a public JSON request exploit.
packages.minimalRemediation: First release fixing all five findings is 5.0.1 (Node >=20). No patched 3.x release found. Anchor requests ^3.0.0; 3 -> 5 is a major upgrade, outside permitted blind patch/minor remediation. Require upstream compatible backport or reviewed Anchor API migration, retaining approved SDKs.

packages.assessment: Only Firebase nested 6.19.7 copies are affected by these audit ranges; root Miniflare 7.30.1 is outside all listed ranges/current GHSA 7.x ranges. Neither Worker bundles Undici: workerd native fetch is not npm Undici. Browser Firebase/node transport is absent.
packages.minimalRemediation: Candidate scoped overrides for five @firebase/* parents: undici 6.19.7 -> 6.29.1 (same-major minor; Node >=18.17 unchanged). Firebase pins 6.19.7, so validate Node SDK HTTP/WebSocket/auth/storage behavior; do not globally override/downgrade Miniflare 7.30.1 or jump to latest 8.x.

advisories.title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided

packages.assessment: Affected nested copies are 8.3.2 and 9.0.1; root 11.1.1 and unified-balance-kit 14.0.3 are safe for this GHSA. Parsed MetaMask UUID modules are tree-shaken out of emitted chunks. GHSA concerns v3/v5/v6 APIs with caller-provided short output buffers, not v4; installed jayson uses v4(). No demonstrated app exploit.
packages.minimalRemediation: First patched release for older majors is 11.1.1; no patched 8.x/9.x release found. Do NOT globally override to 11: major/API/package export differences require consumer regression. Prefer narrow upstream compatible consumer fix/backport; retain safe existing root 11.1.1 and 14.0.3.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections

packages.assessment: Public Worker actually resolves/emits root 4.6.7 (patched); private Worker has no Zod. Browser transforms root 4.6.7 but emits no Zod; Reown 3.22.4 remains lock-only and was checked separately. Older transitive copies remain in approved SDKs. Bounded max(1) invalid-array check: v4.6.7 reports 1 issue vs v3.25.67 and v3.22.4 reporting 1001 for 1000 items, so older code cannot be dismissed as harmless name/range noise. Public readBody additionally caps streamed bytes at 256 KiB.
packages.minimalRemediation: Keep root 4.6.7. GHSA first patched 4.6.6; registry has no patched 3.x backport. Do NOT force SDK zod 3 -> 4: major schema/API incompatibilities. Require upstream SDK compatible fix/backport or reviewed, bounded/non-reachable input disposition per consumer; root upgrade alone cannot clean the lock audit.

remainingReleaseGates: Do not report bun audit passing: captured exit 1 and all nine package findings remain unresolved in the lockfile.

Review/approve precise compatible remediation or documented threat-boundary disposition; scoped same-major candidates grpc 1.13.6 and undici 6.29.1 require pinned-consumer compatibility checks. Esbuild scoped candidate 0.25.12 has only a small scratch transform smoke, not full migration acceptance.

No compatible patch/minor fixes established for decode 0.2.x, elliptic, stream-json 1.x, toml 3.x, uuid 8/9 or zod 3. Do not use broad overrides/SDK removal to claim closure; obtain compatible upstream fix/backport or explicit reviewed bounded non-reachability disposition.

After an approved minimal lock change, use isolated credential-free pinned Bun frozen install, rerun audit, regenerate runtime graphs and full source tests/build/signed acceptance. Current triage is not full-matrix acceptance.

No production funded key may be passed through vulnerable elliptic signing. No untrusted Node stream/TOML/URI decode or older Zod input without bounded/trusted input review. Current Workers/browser absence is a scoped exposure result, not a license for future use.
Parent must finish independent authorization/headers/runner fixes, final current-source matrix, provider CPU/quota/owner/deployment gates; this report does not close Phase 5.
